method: No HCX recall. Frozen answer_hash, resolver/selector trace, selected context, and manually fixed gold evidence were compared.

failures.finding: The question uses 확정기여형 without the DC acronym. The resolver has no canonical alias from 확정기여형/확정기여형퇴직연금 to DC, so it stops before selector/retrieval.

IRP를 함께 쓰지 않고 연금저축만 contains both explicit entities. The resolver preserves both and has no exclusion/only operator, so it returns non_unique_active_subject although the requested scope is pension_savings only.
product.total_fee was selected and the exact annual total-fee table was in context. HCX named only the generic 지급비율 table and omitted the decisive 총보수·비용/합성총보수·비용 field.
product.period_cost was selected and the exact period-cost table was in context. HCX mentioned class rows but omitted the factual table identity and requested 3-year column distinction.
The resolved second product and product.total_fee were correct, and the direct annual fee table was present. HCX substituted a class row for the requested total-fee field.
The exact period-cost table explicitly lists 1·2·3·5·10-year columns. HCX answered only 몇 년 단위 and lost every requested value.
The direct annual total-fee table was present. HCX listed component fees instead of identifying the 총보수·비용 field that must be distinguished from 판매수수료.
Both DB.operation_party and DB.benefit_determination were selected. The direct 30-day average-wage formula chunk was in context, but HCX shortened it to 평균임금 × 계속근로기간.

conclusion: The tested fee/cost cases are not retrieval or direct-field-binding failures: their exact gold chunks were supplied to HCX. Fine-tuning candidates may be collected from the six answer-generation failures, but P45 remains No-Go because two resolver failures are still structural.
